headline: PHI @ PIT matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is PHI 3.66 at PIT 4.38, with a projected total of 8.05. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward PIT: PHI moved -0.13 runs while PIT moved +0.71, changing the projected margin by -0.84 runs. The projected total climbed +0.59, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. Pitching context: Braxton Ashcraft has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available start logs at 2.2 ER over the last 5 starts. Batter research is strongest for Brandon Marsh, Konnor Griffin, Spencer Horwitz, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Billy Cook, Adolis García because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
